name: Burlington Masjid Camp 2026
description: Labor Day Weekend · Friday, September 4 – Sunday, September 6, 2026 · YMCA Camp Weaver, Greensboro NC · Theme: Surah Al-Kahf

settings.intro:
This year's theme is Surah Al-Kahf.

The Prophet (peace be upon him) taught us to recite Surah Al-Kahf every Jumu'ah, and it is a surah built around four trials — and how a believer stands through each of them:

  • The trial of faith — the People of the Cave, who left everything for the sake of Allah and were given refuge.
  • The trial of wealth — the man with two gardens, who forgot Who gave them to him.
  • The trial of knowledge — Musa (AS) and Al-Khidr, and learning that we do not see the whole picture.
  • The trial of power — Dhul-Qarnayn, who was given the earth and stayed humble before his Lord.

Over the weekend our halaqas, activities and evening sessions walk through these four stories together, insha'Allah.

Check-in Friday, September 4 at 6:00 PM. Departure Sunday, September 6 at 2:35 PM.
Where YMCA Camp Weaver, 4924 Tapawingo Trail, Greensboro, NC 27406.
Ages 7 and up.

Registration pricing, per person:

  • $100 — early bird, through August 14
  • $120 — August 15 through September 3
  • $140 — registering on the day of camp

The price is set by the date you register, and the total shown below is what you owe. Every registration includes two nights of climate-controlled cabin lodging, all halal meals from Friday dinner through Sunday lunch, and every camp activity.

Brothers and sisters follow separate activity tracks; swimming is always private to one group at a time.

Questions: Sr. Amal 336-567-6340 · Br. Kassim 202-744-5603

fields.bodyText: I certify that the attendee(s) are physically able to take part. In the event of injury or illness, I authorize camp staff and the released parties to obtain or administer first aid and to arrange emergency medical treatment as deemed necessary. fields.name: photoConsent

fields.bodyText: Burlington Masjid may take photographs or video at camp for documentation and promotional purposes. Attending constitutes consent to general event photography unless you decline. Privacy at sisters-only sessions: no photographs or video will be taken during sisters-only activities unless explicit, specific consent is given by those present — a general grant here does not override that protection.

options.label: I GRANT permission for photos/video to be used by Burlington Masjid.

fields.bodyText: Attendees will conduct themselves respectfully, follow the instructions of organizers and volunteers, observe the rules of camp and the venue, and behave in a manner befitting the values of the masjid. Burlington Masjid may dismiss a participant for conduct that is unsafe or seriously disruptive, without refund, and a parent or guardian may be asked to arrange pick-up of a minor.

fields.bodyText: Your total is the price per person for the date you register, multiplied by the number of attendees you list. Submitting this form commits you to that amount whether or not payment has been sent yet. If you pay by card on the masjid terminal, a 3% service charge is added to the total.
